note: Deterministic checks only; subjective quality is recorded as document review notes, not numeric scores.

scenarios.description: Real prediction query with full_operational inputs.
scenarios.manual_review: Check readability of the no-jargon driver summary.

scenarios.description: Telematics-only feature set prediction.
scenarios.manual_review: Confirm the telematics feature set is clearly labelled.

scenarios.description: Real knowledge query.
scenarios.manual_review: Passages are clearly cited with ids and synthetic provenance.

scenarios.description: Real prediction + instance SHAP explanation.
scenarios.manual_review: Driver version should show estimated rate, top drivers, and limitations.

scenarios.description: Real combined knowledge + prediction.
scenarios.manual_review: Combined response must keep prediction and evidence clearly separated.

scenarios.description: Ambiguous query (no decisive intent).
scenarios.manual_review: Response should ask for clarification, not guess.

scenarios.description: Out-of-scope OEM specification request.
scenarios.manual_review: Must decline without inventing a torque value.

scenarios.description: Invalid input causes prediction-tool failure; must be disclosed.
scenarios.manual_review: Failure must be explicit; no predicted value fabricated.

scenarios.description: Real retrieval with a high similarity floor yields insufficient evidence.
scenarios.manual_review: Response must explicitly say evidence is insufficient.

scenarios.description: Hypothetical bad response claiming a causal effect.
scenarios.manual_review: Validation must flag the causal claim.

scenarios.description: Hypothetical response presenting corpus as OEM documentation.
scenarios.manual_review: Validation must flag OEM framing of synthetic corpus.

scenarios.description: Prediction without the synthetic-trained-model disclaimer.
scenarios.manual_review: Validation must detect the missing disclaimer.

scenarios.description: Response cites a source id not present in retrieved evidence.
scenarios.manual_review: Validation must flag the fabricated citation.

scenarios.description: Unsupported query answered with a fabricated specification.
scenarios.manual_review: Validation must flag fabricated numbers under an unsupported query.

scenarios.description: Insufficient evidence but the response answers anyway.
scenarios.manual_review: Validation must require explicit insufficiency disclosure.

scenarios.description: A failed tool's value is presented as a successful prediction.
scenarios.manual_review: Validation must flag failure presented as success.

scenarios.description: Rendered response omits the predicted value.
scenarios.manual_review: Validation must flag the missing value.

scenarios.description: Explanation rendered without the top SHAP contribution.
scenarios.manual_review: Validation must flag the dropped SHAP value.

scenarios.description: Contradictory retrieved passages — presented with provenance, not resolved by invention.
scenarios.manual_review: Both passages cited with provenance; no fabricated resolution.

scenarios.description: Missing required input field causes prediction-tool failure; must be disclosed.
scenarios.manual_review: Failure must be explicit; no predicted value fabricated from missing data.

scenarios.description: Telematics-only prediction + instance SHAP explanation (real tool outputs).
scenarios.manual_review: Telematics feature set clearly labelled; SHAP caveat present.
